title: fix(app-shell): pair-added permission sets read Custom in the Studio Access header
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb3FmxaqPgrTCbqWhPEB9xY2)_
Fixes #29809

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Studio「权限」中，定制包（`.custom`）里的权限集（「新建类似」复制的，或在定制包里新建的）头部标签不再显示「包内置」，而是与左侧列表的「新增」一致，显示自定义标签。
- 为什么改：管理员打开自己复制的权限集，头部却说它是包内置的，无法判断这是谁的权限集、升级包时会不会被覆盖。
- 风险与回滚：只改头部标签选哪个词，判据取自左侧列表已用的定制标记（`customizationMarks.ts`），不新增读取；基础包自带的权限集、被定制的基础包权限集仍显示「包内置」；Setup 与元数据管理页不传标记，行为不变。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx` 的 `shippedByPackage` 一行；`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` 中 Access 宿主传入 `customizationMark` 的一行；`StudioDesignSurface.accessPairCopy-29674.test.tsx` 新增的三个用例。
- 两分钟验证：`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.accessPairCopy-29674.test.tsx -t 29809`，应见 3 个用例通过（复制件、定制包新建件为自定义，基础包权限集为包内置）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **The provenance rule** (`PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx`): `shippedByPackage` was `!!packageId || codeIsArtifact`. The pair's package door supplies a `packageId`, so every set a base's `.custom` pair holds read "Package" in the Studio header while the rail marked the same row "Added". It is now `customizationMark !== 'added' && (!!packageId || codeIsArtifact)`. Both badge sites (the page badge and the Studio header chip) still read that one value; no badge string, legend or key is touched.
- **The mark comes from the host** (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, `AccessPillar`): a new optional page prop `customizationMark` (type `CustomizationMarkKind` from `customizationMarks.ts`). The pillar passes `railMarks?.markOf(...)` for the open set, the same call the rail row's `RailCustomizationMark` makes, so the rule is the one `customizationMarks.ts` holds (ADR-0146 D3) and is not derived a second time.
- **Unchanged:** a set the read-only base ships still reads Package; a customized base set (a served override) still reads Package, since the base ships it; Setup's permission page and the metadata admin pass no mark.

## Tests

- `StudioDesignSurface.accessPairCopy-29674.test.tsx`, one new top-level describe in the existing real-client harness (real `StudioDesignSurface`, `AccessPillar` and `PermissionMatrixEditPage` over the real metadata client and a fetch stub; base read-only, pair writable):
  - a New similar copy in the pair: the header chip reads Custom and the rail row carries the `added` mark;
  - a set created in the pair (its draft only, listed from the pair's drafts): the same;
  - CONTROL: the base's own set reads Package and its rail row carries no mark.
- `StudioDesignSurface.accessTabs-12456.test.tsx` (the Package pin for a package's own set) stays green, unchanged.
- Ablations, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` with the on-disk proof and a proven restore to HEAD:
  - the rule back to `!!packageId || codeIsArtifact`: the two pair cases red, the control green;
  - the host passing `customizationMark={null}`: the two pair cases red, the control green.

<details><summary>Test runs (fix at 26d194d4; re-run at the merged head 27943c85)</summary>

- New describe plus `accessTabs-12456`: Test Files 2 passed (2), Tests 16 passed (16).
- Every ui test file naming `PermissionMatrixEdit`, `AccessPillar` or `perm-provenance-badge` (68 files): Test Files 68 passed (68), Tests 474 passed (474).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check`: exit 0. `eslint` on the three touched files: 0 errors (the warnings are on lines this diff does not touch).
- At 27943c85 (after merging main, closure rebuilt): the same 68 files, Test Files 68 passed (68), Tests 474 passed (474); app-shell type-check exit 0; `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` exit 0.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- While the base's customization read is in flight, or after it fails, the rail draws no mark, so the header keeps its previous answer (Package) for a pair set. The two agree; no fallback to the row's `addedIn` was added, since that would be a second copy of the rule (seat ruling on the plan).
- The chip's words are untouched here. The card #29729 renames the Custom badge's text, and whichever PR lands second merges main.
- Not measured live: no dev server run. The real-client harness drives the surface end to end; the card measured the rail's "Added" live on `601832b1a6`, and an `added` mark now decides the header regardless of the layered `code` reading.
